input:
Perfetto GPU counters show our Mali-G720 is 98% fragment bound, but Android GPU Inspector shows zero overdraw. The scene is a simple 2D UI with no transparency and no overlapping draw calls. We expected to be vertex bound or even CPU bound given the simplicity.

Perfetto GPU metrics (1-second window):
  GPU Utilization: 78%
  Fragment Bound: 98.2%
  Non-Fragment Bound: 1.8%
  Shader Core Cycles: 142,000,000
  Fragment Jobs: 60
  Non-Fragment Jobs: 60
  L2 Cache Miss Rate: 45%
  Texture Fetch Stalls: 89,000,000 cycles

AGI overdraw analysis:
  Overdraw 1x: 100%
  Overdraw 2x: 0%
  Overdraw 3x: 0%
  Overdraw 4x+: 0%

The frame renders 6 layers at 1080x2400 resolution. Each layer is a full-screen textured quad with a 4K texture source (center-crop). Total texture memory accessed per frame: ~120MB.

With no overdraw, why is fragment shading the bottleneck?
